newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures firmer in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were firmer in the after-hours session on Friday, as short-covering emerged after all contracts hit their life-of-contract lows during the day, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.3 yen to 1.6 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark March was up 0.3 yen at 132.0 yen.

Volume was 12,290 lots. During the day, the market was under selling pressure as weaker overseas markets and a perception that the yen's further fall will be limited, undermined sentiment. Traders said direction hinges on the announcement of rubber stock figures on Monday.
